    df_print: paged
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)
```

```{r}
# Define input/output
input_dir = "D:\\OExpOut\\adapt_res\\results\\lme"
output_dir = "D:\\OExpOut\\adapt_res\\results\\lme"

# Load data
data_table <- read.csv(paste0(input_dir, "\\component_amplitudes.csv"))

# Get N2 counts for denominator
N2_data <- data_table[data_table$sov == "N2", ]
N2_counts <- aggregate(trials_count ~ subject + cond, N2_data, sum)
names(N2_counts)[3] <- "N2_count"

# Get Kc and Ss counts
Kc_data <- data_table[data_table$sov == "N2EliwJKc", ]
Kc_counts <- aggregate(trials_count ~ subject + cond, Kc_data, sum)
names(Kc_counts)[3] <- "Kc_count"

Ss_data <- data_table[data_table$sov == "N2EliwJSs", ]
Ss_counts <- aggregate(trials_count ~ subject + cond, Ss_data, sum)
names(Ss_counts)[3] <- "Ss_count"

# Merge and calculate proportions
Kc_merged <- merge(Kc_counts, N2_counts, by = c("subject", "cond"))
Kc_merged$proportion <- Kc_merged$Kc_count / Kc_merged$N2_count
Kc_merged$torder <- as.numeric(substr(Kc_merged$cond, nchar(Kc_merged$cond), nchar(Kc_merged$cond)))

Ss_merged <- merge(Ss_counts, N2_counts, by = c("subject", "cond"))
Ss_merged$proportion <- Ss_merged$Ss_count / Ss_merged$N2_count
Ss_merged$torder <- as.numeric(substr(Ss_merged$cond, nchar(Ss_merged$cond), nchar(Ss_merged$cond)))
```

```{r}
########## K-COMPLEX ANALYSIS ##########

Kc_data <- Kc_merged[!is.na(Kc_merged$proportion) & !is.nan(Kc_merged$proportion), ]
Kc_data$subject <- factor(Kc_data$subject)
Kc_data$torder_factor <- factor(Kc_data$torder, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4))

output_file <- paste0(output_dir, "\\preval_Kc_results.txt")
sink(output_file)

cat("=== PREVALENCE ANALYSIS: K-COMPLEX ===\n")
cat("Date:", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n\n")

# Models (torder as numeric for linear trend, 1 df)
model_null <- lmer(proportion ~ (1|subject), data = Kc_data)
model_torder <- lmer(proportion ~ torder + (1|subject), data = Kc_data)

BF <- function(bic1, bic2) exp((bic1 - bic2)/2)

cat("=== MODEL COMPARISON ===\n")
print(anova(model_null, model_torder))
cat("BF =", BF(BIC(model_null), BIC(model_torder)), "\n\n")

cat("=== MODEL SUMMARY ===\n")
print(summary(model_torder))

cat("\n=== TYPE III ANOVA ===\n")
print(anova(model_torder))

# Post-hoc with emmeans (using factor model for pairwise comparisons)
cat("\n=== POST-HOC (emmeans) ===\n")
model_factor <- lmer(proportion ~ torder_factor + (1|subject), data = Kc_data)
emm <- emmeans(model_factor, ~ torder_factor)
print(emm)

pairs_result <- pairs(emm, adjust = "none")
pairs_summary <- summary(pairs_result, infer = TRUE)

# Get consecutive comparisons (1-2, 2-3, 3-4)
consecutive_idx <- c(1, 4, 6)
consec_pairs <- pairs_summary[consecutive_idx, ]

cat("\nConsecutive comparisons (T1-T2, T2-T3, T3-T4):\n")
print(consec_pairs)

cat("\n=== ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
sink()
cat("K-complex results saved to:", output_file, "\n")
```

```{r}
########## SPINDLE ANALYSIS ##########
```

```{r}
########## PLOTS ##########

mustard_colors <- c("#FFF8DC", "#F0E68C", "#DAA520", "#B8860B")

# K-complex plot
Kc_plot_data <- Kc_merged[!is.na(Kc_merged$proportion), ]
Kc_plot_data$percentage <- Kc_plot_data$proportion * 100
Kc_plot_data$torder_factor <- factor(Kc_plot_data$torder, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
                                      labels = c("T1", "T2", "T3", "T4"))

p_kc <- ggplot(Kc_plot_data, aes(x = torder_factor, y = percentage, fill = torder_factor)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 21, size = 3, fill = "white", stroke = 1.5) +
  labs(title = "K-complex Prevalence Across Tone Repetitions",
       x = "Tone Repetition", y = "% of N2 Trials") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mustard_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

print(p_kc)
ggsave(paste0(output_dir, "\\preval_Kc_boxplot.svg"), plot = p_kc, width = 6, height = 5)

# Spindle plot
Ss_plot_data <- Ss_merged[!is.na(Ss_merged$proportion), ]
Ss_plot_data$percentage <- Ss_plot_data$proportion * 100
Ss_plot_data$torder_factor <- factor(Ss_plot_data$torder, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
                                      labels = c("T1", "T2", "T3", "T4"))

p_ss <- ggplot(Ss_plot_data, aes(x = torder_factor, y = percentage, fill = torder_factor)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 21, size = 3, fill = "white", stroke = 1.5) +
  labs(title = "Spindle Prevalence Across Tone Repetitions",
       x = "Tone Repetition", y = "% of N2 Trials") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mustard_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

print(p_ss)
ggsave(paste0(output_dir, "\\preval_Ss_boxplot.svg"), plot = p_ss, width = 6, height = 5)

cat("\nAll prevalence analyses complete!\n")
```
